sourceRefs.locator: Entries 749 and 750: petition to Zacharias, elevation at Soissons, Boniface and the tonsure of Childeric. Entries 753–754: papal visit, anointing of Pippin and both sons.
“The Carolingians”, opening paragraphs and notes 35–37, 46: late testimony about 751, Boniface, and papal letters recalling the anointing of Pippin and his sons in 754.
“Un programme architectural voulu par les Carolingiens”, first two paragraphs: the basilica as the site of the 754 ceremony and later rebuilding under Fulrad.

note.de: Die Markierung verweist auf die frühmittelalterliche Basilika am selben Ort, die später umgebaut wurde.
note.en: The outline marks the early medieval basilica at this site, which underwent later rebuilding.

note.de: Stephan II. salbte Pippin sowie dessen Söhne Karl und Karlmann in Saint-Denis.
note.en: Stephen II anointed Pippin and his sons Charles and Carloman at Saint-Denis.
